scope: Local only; no production access or deployment
finding: Explanation images previously depended on public-disk /storage URLs. The reported production failure itself was not reproduced against the live server.
fix: Serve stored exercise and plan-item images through authenticated Laravel endpoints, independent of the web-server storage alias.
Generate image URLs on the current application request origin.
Use current app session for same-origin training image requests in editor, content view and plan thumbnails. Never send the token to external image hosts.
Check exercise/plan access on every image request; unpublished plans stay private.
static_analysis: No errors; four existing style notices in training_plans_logs_screen.dart.
manual_device_test: Not performed; no connected test device used.
local_test: Run a debug app against that local backend, or use a suitable local test build. The release APK defaults to airmius.com.
Create a test exercise, add a JPG/PNG/WebP image and save. Reopen editor, library and web view.
Copy exercise into a plan and check image previews. Test a foreign account and a draft recipient; image requests must be denied.
data_limit: Missing original image files cannot be recovered by this change; existing stored files need not be uploaded again.
